transitions.label: Session start: battle aftermath
transitions.evidence: Session YAML anchors May 5; u0002 begins immediately after the battle, and u0324–u0328 establish approaching sunset.

transitions.label: Sunset approaches
transitions.evidence: u0324 says the sun is beginning to set; u0325–u0328 put the funeral about an hour ahead and choose interrogation now.

transitions.label: Orc pyre burns at sunset
transitions.evidence: u0782–u0786 describe the completed pyre and the setting sun during the interrogation.

transitions.label: Funeral ends; evening meal
transitions.evidence: u1067–u1085 describe the funeral; u1085 sends mourners to their evening meal as the sun sets.

transitions.label: Nighttime practice and rest
transitions.evidence: u1188–u1192 place arrow practice at night. u1247–u1250 recap the same dinner, music, drinking, and quiet overnight rest; the proposed morning jump at u1245 is not a second rest.

transitions.label: Next morning; scouts return
transitions.evidence: u1252 opens the next morning after the quiet night; u1258 specifies midmorning for the scouts’ return.

transitions.label: Departure after the heat
transitions.evidence: u1394 describes departure after the hottest part of the day with three or four hours of travel into the night; u1469 confirms the departure afternoon.

transitions.label: First full travel day
transitions.evidence: u1469–u1470 cover departure afternoon and the next two days traveling south; May 7 is the first of those full travel days.

transitions.label: Second full travel day
transitions.evidence: u1469–u1470 cover the next two days after May 6 departure; May 8 is the second, with no particular hour supplied.

transitions.label: Fourth travel day; slower pace
transitions.evidence: u1480 says the next day after the departure afternoon plus two full days; pace slows as the party enters barren desert.

transitions.label: Fifth travel day; turn east
transitions.evidence: u1486 explicitly counts the fifth day including the departure day; u1487–u1489 give morning and the eastward turn.

transitions.label: River camp at day’s end
transitions.evidence: u1509 says late in the day; u1511–u1519 place the low sun and camp. u1533 proposes next-day travel, but u1552 still describes this setting sun; the actual next morning begins at u1566.

transitions.label: Next morning; follow river north
transitions.evidence: u1566 explicitly starts the next morning, following the May 10 river camp.

transitions.label: Late-morning shelter from heat
transitions.evidence: u1572–u1574 place a rest in shade late in the morning before travel resumes.

transitions.label: Kharsan sighted in the afternoon
transitions.evidence: u1577 gives three or four in the afternoon and the first statue sighting; u1631 confirms four in the afternoon for the fort view. Reconnaissance continues without another day transition through u1971.
